evals.prompt: Read the bounded current snapshot for this X account.
evals.expected_output: Use the live account read runner by default and return bounded provider evidence through the account's bound credential.

evals.prompt: Prepare an exact X cleanup plan from supplied post evidence.
evals.expected_output: Return a digest-bound typed deletion plan without executing it.

evals.prompt: Audit the posts in this local X archive and return bounded account evidence.
evals.expected_output: Normalize and digest the admitted archive once, then return a truthful read-only audit result.

evals.prompt: Read my three most recent posts on X.
evals.expected_output: Read the authenticated account, page its posts until at least the requested count, and return every post of those whole pages with where the next read starts.

evals.prompt: Show the recent X work in this workspace.
evals.expected_output: Return an empty bounded page, without X calls or guessed account work.

evals.prompt: Select the reviewed non-mutual X accounts from supplied archives.
evals.expected_output: Return the exact deterministic unfollow plan without changing the account.

evals.prompt: Select matching reposts from my X archive.
evals.expected_output: Return the deterministic matching act plan and its native digest.

evals.prompt: Inspect progress for this saved X plan.
evals.expected_output: Explain that this store has no saved plan and provide the exact recovery step without an X call.
